title: Underground Lab
statementMd:
The evil Bumbershoot corporation produces clones for gruesome experiments in a vast underground lab. On one occasion, the corp cloned a boy Andryusha who was smarter than his comrades. Immediately Andryusha understood that something fishy was going on there. He rallied fellow clones to go on a feud against the evil corp, and they set out to find an exit from the lab. The corp had to reduce to destroy the lab complex.

The lab can be pictured as a connected graph with $*n*$ vertices and $*m*$ edges. $*k*$ clones of Andryusha start looking for an exit in some of the vertices. Each clone can traverse any edge once per second. Any number of clones are allowed to be at any vertex simultaneously. Each clone is allowed to stop looking at any time moment, but he must look at his starting vertex at least. The exit can be located at any vertex of the lab, hence each vertex must be visited by at least one clone.

Each clone can visit at most ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/ca488ee5e135b348ee057febf8f9fd8dacf0823c.png) vertices before the lab explodes.

Your task is to choose starting vertices and searching routes for the clones. Each route can have at most ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/ca488ee5e135b348ee057febf8f9fd8dacf0823c.png) vertices.

## Input

The first line contains three integers $*n*$, $*m*$, and $*k*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 2·10^{5}$, $*n* - 1 ≤ *m* ≤ 2·10^{5}$, $1 ≤ *k* ≤ *n*$) — the number of vertices and edges in the lab, and the number of clones.

Each of the next $*m*$ lines contains two integers $*x*_{*i*}$ and $*y*_{*i*}$ ($1 ≤ *x*_{*i*}, *y*_{*i*} ≤ *n*$) — indices of vertices connected by the respective edge. The graph is allowed to have self-loops and multiple edges.

The graph is guaranteed to be connected.

## Output

You should print $*k*$ lines. $*i*$-th of these lines must start with an integer $*c*_{*i*}$ (![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/a4248573a7b301961c88be0cee191bf1f4421991.png)) — the number of vertices visited by $*i*$-th clone, followed by $*c*_{*i*}$ integers — indices of vertices visited by this clone in the order of visiting. You have to print each vertex every time it is visited, regardless if it was visited earlier or not.

It is guaranteed that a valid answer exists.

## Note

In the first sample case there is only one clone who may visit vertices in order (2, 1, 3), which fits the constraint of 6 vertices per clone.

In the second sample case the two clones can visited vertices in order (2, 1, 3) and (4, 1, 5), which fits the constraint of 5 vertices per clone.
statementZhMd:
邪恶的 Bumbershoot 公司在一个巨大的地下实验室中制造克隆人，用于进行惨无人道的实验。有一次，公司克隆出了一个名叫 Andryusha 的男孩，他比自己的同伴更加聪明。Andryusha 立即意识到这里正在发生可疑的事情。他召集其他克隆人，向邪恶的公司发起反抗，并开始寻找实验室的出口。公司不得不决定摧毁整个实验室建筑群。

实验室可以表示为一个具有 $*n*$ 个顶点和 $*m*$ 条边的连通图。$*k*$ 个 Andryusha 的克隆人从其中一些顶点出发，开始寻找出口。每个克隆人每秒可以经过一条边。任意多个克隆人可以同时位于同一个顶点。每个克隆人都可以在任意时刻停止寻找，但他至少必须查看自己的起始顶点。出口可能位于实验室的任意顶点，因此每个顶点都必须至少被一个克隆人访问。

在实验室爆炸前，每个克隆人最多可以访问 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/ca488ee5e135b348ee057febf8f9fd8dacf0823c.png) 个顶点。

你的任务是为克隆人选择起始顶点和搜索路线。每条路线最多可以包含 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/ca488ee5e135b348ee057febf8f9fd8dacf0823c.png) 个顶点。

## 输入

第一行包含三个整数 $*n*$、$*m*$ 和 $*k*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 2·10^{5}$，$*n* - 1 ≤ *m* ≤ 2·10^{5}$，$1 ≤ *k* ≤ *n*$）——实验室中的顶点数、边数以及克隆人数。

接下来的 $*m*$ 行中，每行包含两个整数 $*x*_{*i*}$ 和 $*y*_{*i*}$（$1 ≤ *x*_{*i*}, *y*_{*i*} ≤ *n*$）——由相应边连接的顶点编号。图中允许存在自环和重边。

保证给定图是连通的。

## 输出

你应当输出 $*k*$ 行。第 $*i*$ 行必须以一个整数 $*c*_{*i*}$（![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/a4248573a7b301961c88be0cee191bf1f4421991.png)）开头，表示第 $*i*$ 个克隆人访问的顶点数，随后输出 $*c*_{*i*}$ 个整数，表示该克隆人按照访问顺序访问的顶点编号。每次访问某个顶点时都必须输出该顶点，无论它之前是否已经被访问过。

保证一定存在合法答案。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，只有一个克隆人，他可以按照顺序 (2, 1, 3) 访问顶点，这满足每个克隆人最多访问 6 个顶点的限制。

在第二个样例中，两个克隆人可以分别按照顺序 (2, 1, 3) 和 (4, 1, 5) 访问顶点，这满足每个克隆人最多访问 5 个顶点的限制。
